items.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 4 Argon, a new AI model designed for tackling complex challenges, signaling advancements in their foundational AI capabilities.

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.summary: OpenAI announces a strategic partnership to integrate its models into Google Cloud, expanding accessibility and offering more options for enterprise users.

items.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
items.summary: Meta's AI assistant, Muse, has surpassed 10 million users, with shopping identified as a primary use case, highlighting AI's growing role in consumer commerce.

items.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
items.summary: New research explores synthesizing environments for computer-use agents, enabling more realistic and scalable training for AI agents in diverse digital settings.

items.title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
items.summary: AT&T is leveraging OpenAI's technology to innovate and streamline its in-house legal operations, demonstrating AI's increasing adoption in corporate functions.

items.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
items.summary: This paper investigates cache engineering techniques to optimize the performance and efficiency of AI agents, crucial for real-world deployment.

items.title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
items.summary: Researchers propose a Socratic learning approach that combines teaching and practice to develop more transferable skills in AI agents.

items.title: AI Made Coding Cheaper. So Why Is Building Software Still So Expensive?
items.summary: This article discusses the paradox of AI reducing coding costs while overall software development expenses remain high, exploring underlying factors.

items.title: Idempotency keys for AI agents: why hashing the arguments doesn't work
items.summary: A practical discussion on the challenges of implementing idempotency for AI agents and why simple argument hashing is insufficient for reliable operations.

items.title: FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
items.summary: New research introduces FlowState, a method that uses execution state as memory to enhance the capabilities of LLM agents in long-horizon tasks.

items.title: AgenticRoboRL: Bringing Coding-Agent Post-Training to Agentic Robotics
items.summary: This paper explores integrating coding-agent post-training techniques into agentic robotics to improve the adaptability and performance of robotic systems.

items.title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
items.summary: Researchers propose a memory-centric approach to continual learning, allowing AI agents to efficiently acquire and retain knowledge over time without forgetting.

items.title: Blackstone’s Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown
items.summary: Blackstone executive Jas Khaira dismisses concerns about excessive debt in AI infrastructure development, suggesting the market is robust.

items.title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
items.summary: New research focuses on improving autoregressive video generation by modeling the future evolution of scenes, leading to more coherent and realistic video outputs.

items.title: From Pilot Purgatory to Agentic Chaos: Why Medium Enterprises Keep Breaking Their Own SDLCs
items.summary: This article analyzes why medium enterprises struggle with AI agent adoption, often disrupting their existing Software Development Life Cycles (SDLCs).
